value.rationale: A rigorous unbounded order barrier for rotationally unregistered surface-normal tomography is structurally useful: no fixed finite m-point normal-angle law identifies all real-analytic positive-curvature plane ovals. The exact first detectable order and its recoverability coefficient are constructive; matching area, perimeter and directional widths rule out familiar auxiliary scalar and one-directional recovery signals. This moves beyond the familiar two-point power-spectrum ambiguity and states a sharp mathematically motivated inverse-geometric boundary.
